LESSON: WRITING 11.4.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: SPELLING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it difficult to spell some words correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify commonly misspelt words in oral and written contexts
2. write commonly misspelt words correctly for communication clarity

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 11.4.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: SPELLING
This lesson teaches Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify commonly misspelt words in oral and written contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write commonly misspelt words correctly for communication clarity
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling above.
2. Explain Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it difficult to spell some words correctly?
2. How can we become better at spelling words?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify commonly misspelt words in oral and written contexts
2. write commonly misspelt words correctly for communication clarity

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
